x: Reservation in promotion was first given by the 77th Amendment (1995, Art. 16(4A)), which is not among the options; of those listed, the 85th Amendment (2001, printed as 2000) is the promotion amendment – it added consequential seniority. The 81st is backlog vacancies.
source: NextGen Polity - APPSC Exams (src/polity/nextgen-polity-full.txt) p.193-194; PMF Polity Notes Part 1 (src/polity/pmf-polity-01.txt) p.61
